items.title: Lee Paige Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: How about Connie Boswell and Ella Mae Morris?

ctx.x: Yes, Mary Martin played in the Broadway show, Louisiana Hayride and also Hollywood Follies. And these other people, I worked with Helen Morgan, too, several times in nightclubs and also taught a girl who went with her show as a course girl.
How about Connie Boswell and Ella Mae Morris?
Yes, Connie Boswell is a dear friend of mine and I knew the Boswell sisters, Connie, Martha and Bette. They're girls from New Orleans.
